request-prompt: Hide all grid metadata, group text elements, and the 'Explore featured boards' section to leave only a clean, distraction-free grid of pure images.
goal: I prefer a clean, minimalist interface that focuses purely on images with as little text, tags, and metadata as possible.
jobs: I want to search for and view cute, funny, or aesthetic cat photos and memes to entertain myself.
I want to refine my search using suggested tags so that I can find specific types of cat content like wallpapers, art, or breeds.
I want to explore curated cat-themed boards to see compiled collections from other users.
I want to click on a specific cat pin to view it in full detail and see its original source.
I want to log in or sign up for an account so that I can save these cat pins to my own boards for future reference.

preference-pairs.a: I prefer infinite scrolling through visual layouts to casually discover unexpected inspiration without a specific objective.
preference-pairs.b: I prefer highly structured search results with precise filters where I can find a specific item or idea as quickly as possible.

preference-pairs.a: I like to meticulously organize and catalog interesting visuals into themed collections or folders for long-term reference and future projects.
preference-pairs.b: I prefer to consume media in the moment or share it directly, and I rarely feel the need to save or organize content for later.

preference-pairs.a: I prefer a clean, minimalist interface that focuses purely on images with as little text, tags, and metadata as possible.
preference-pairs.b: I prefer having detailed context, tags, titles, and creator information clearly visible alongside images to help me evaluate them.

preference: I prefer a clean, minimalist interface that focuses purely on images with as little text, tags, and metadata as possible.
